title: GST Council to Review Key Reforms: Arrest Powers and Gold/Silver IGST Exemption on Agenda!
content:
# GST Council to Review Key Reforms: Arrest Powers and Gold/Silver IGST Exemption on Agenda!

Ek important update hai. Government ke sources ke mutabik, GST Council apni upcoming meeting mein kuch significant reforms par विचार karne wali hai. Specifically, tax officers ki arrest powers ko remove karne aur gold/silver imports par milne wali IGST exemption ko withdraw karne ke proposals par discussion hoga.

Ye proposals October 7, 2026 ko hone wali GST Council ki meeting ke agenda ka hissa hain. In reforms ka main focus GST enforcement ko streamline karna, compliance ko easy banana aur overall tax administration ko proportional banana hai.

Yahan proposals ke key points hain:

*   **Removal of Arrest Powers:** Currently, Central GST Act ka Section 69 Commissioner ko certain conditions mein arrest authorize karne ki power deta hai. Proposed changes mein is power ko GST officials se hata kar, kisi bhi arrest ke liye judicial authorization require karne ka sujhav hai. Iska aim hai tax disputes ko criminal proceedings tak pahunchne se rokna, jahan underlying liability abhi determine nahi hui hai.
*   **Withdrawal of IGST Exemption on Gold/Silver/Platinum Imports:** Banks aur government-nominated agencies ko gold, silver, aur platinum ke imports par milne wali Integrated GST (IGST) exemption ko withdraw karne ka proposal bhi consider kiya ja raha hai. Yeh exemption 2017 mein introduce ki gayi thi. Is move ka objective precious metal imports ko curb karna aur bullion exchanges ke saath tax treatment ko align karna hai.
*   **Increased Prosecution Threshold:** GST prosecution ke liye threshold ko Rs 1 crore se badha kar Rs 5 crore karne ka bhi proposal hai. Isse criminal proceedings sirf serious cases tak hi seemit rahengi, jin mein substantial tax evasion ya fraud involved ho.
*   **Narrowing Scope of Offences:** Prosecution provisions ke under aane wale offences ki list ko bhi narrow karne ka plan hai, taki routine disputes jaise classification, valuation, ya Input Tax Credit (ITC) matters criminal process se bahar rahen.

Ye changes business community ke liye bade relief ho sakte hain aur enforcement ko aur zyada focused banayenge. Filhaal, ye sabhi proposals hain aur final decision GST Council ki meeting ke baad hi aayega.
